title: Every feedback from a registered scorer must get scorerName and scorerVersion metadata, including error feedback
answers: error assessment has no scorer name or version
how is a judge's assessment traced to its registered version
where are scorer provenance metadata fields set
body:
Invariant: each Feedback produced by a registered scorer carries mlflow.assessment.scorerName and mlflow.assessment.scorerVersion, on success and on error paths alike.
Enforced at mlflow/genai/evaluation/utils.py:add_scorer_metadata, called from mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:_compute_eval_scores (run_scorer), mlflow/genai/evaluation/session_utils.py:run_scorer (both the success return and the exception branch), and mlflow/genai/scorers/online/trace_processor.py:_log_error_assessments.
What breaks if skipped: error feedback is logged without provenance, so a failed score cannot be tied to the exact registered version that produced it.
Constraints: the helper merges into existing feedback.metadata and does not overwrite other keys; it is a no-op when scorer.scorer_version is None (unregistered scorers get no fields); the version is stored as a string.
Applies: any new code path that turns a scorer invocation (value or exception) into Feedback objects.
applies: Assessment creation for scorers across harness, session-level and online error logging; does not apply to feedback created outside scorer execution.
says: Failed evaluation runs do not show which version of the judge produced the error.
Evaluation failure details are missing the evaluator name and version tags.
Link failed trace assessment records back to the registered judge that ran them.
Show the evaluator name and release version even when an assessment produces an error.
Audit logs for failed scoring jobs do not identify the exact registered scorer version.
